meta.title: Nazar Yaremiiy (Nazar Yaremii) · Software Engineer
meta.description: Nazar Yaremiiy, also known as Nazar Yaremii, Назар Яремій and nyaremiiy, is a Software Engineer building websites and apps from Figma to launch.

hero.title: Software Engineer
hero.lead: I take on any project: a website, web app, Telegram bot, ERP system or mobile app. I take projects from Figma design to launch on my own server, using the AI tools Claude Code and Codex.
hero.mentorText: I teach programming: groups and one-on-one

about.label: About
about.title: My story
about.lead: I'm a Software Engineer who handles a project end to end: from a Figma mockup to launch on my own server.

cards.title: The start
cards.text: I began with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and by 2023 I was teaching them at HackITStudio. Explaining things to others made me understand them deeper.

cards.title: Experience
cards.text: I completed 7 SoftServe Academy courses, and since 2025 I've been a Software Engineer at INIT Energy: websites from scratch, Odoo ERP, servers.

cards.title: Next
cards.text: I'm growing in backend, DevOps and mobile development to lead a product on my own from idea to launch.

about.ai: I work with Claude Code and OpenAI Codex every day, which helps me write, review and debug code faster.

init.name: INIT ENERGY
init.text: Website of the company I work at. INIT Energy designs and installs solar power plants and backup power systems for apartments, homes and businesses.
features: Solar plant and battery sizing calculator

komar.name: KOMAR
komar.text: Website for a Ukrainian maker of initiation boards and electronics for unmanned systems: products, model comparison and ordering.
features: Catalog of V3.5 and V5 boards and contact switches
Open Graph for social sharing, AVIF images

molytva.name: Moya Molytva
molytva.text: My own website of prayers for life's important moments. It helps people find the words when they have none. It runs on my own Ubuntu server, which I administer myself.
features: Users can submit their own prayers

bakery.name: Shop Bakery
bakery.text: Landing page for a modern bakery franchise chain. Built with no frameworks or dependencies, focused on performance and accessibility.
features: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no build step
Native <dialog> for the modal and mobile menu
CSS scroll-snap carousel instead of Swiper
WebP images: from ~2.1 MB down to ~0.3 MB
Google Maps loads only near the contacts
Accessibility: skip link, reduced motion, form validation

mentoring.title: I teach programming
mentoring.lead: I'm recruiting groups and taking students for one-on-one lessons. Programming builds logic and analytical thinking, teaches how to break hard problems into simple steps and see things through. I taught at HackITStudio and use these skills every day in real projects.

plans.text: Classes in a small group, shared projects and reviewed homework.

plans.title: One-on-one
plans.text: A program built around the student's goals and pace, code reviews and help with their own project.

mentoring.schedule: Lessons are mostly in the evenings and on weekends. The exact schedule is agreed individually.
